Detailed Description

Clovis Object Repository (COR) is an in-memory object oriented distributed database.

It implements data management capabilities such as object creation, deletion, query, indexing, distribution, transaction and recovery. COR is a mechanism by which the Information Model pertaining to a Telecommunication or Data Communication system is captured. The Clovis Object repository is updated in the active System Controller instance and an exact replica is maintained (synchronized) in the System Controller StandBy to provide High Availability. In addition COR provides persistence storage of the repository to provide HA across restart scenarios.
